instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with Kustomize common labels
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./kustomize --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --kustomize-common-label 'app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=argocd'

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with Kustomize common annotations
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./kustomize --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --kustomize-common-annotation 'backstage.io/view-url=https://github.com/user/repo'

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with Kustomize name prefix
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./kustomize --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --kustomize-name-prefix prod-

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with Kustomize name suffix
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./kustomize --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --kustomize-name-suffix -prod

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with Kustomize version
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./kustomize --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --kustomize-version v5.0.0

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with a Helm values file from URL
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./charts/my-app --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --helm-values https://config.example.com/values-prod.yaml

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with a Helm file parameter
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./charts/my-app --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --helm-file parameters=params.yaml

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application in a specific project
output: argocd app create my-app --project my-project --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./k8s --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default

instruction: How to move an ArgoCD application to a different project
output: argocd app set my-app --project new-project

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with a cluster destination URL
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./k8s --dest-server https://prod-cluster:6443 --dest-namespace default

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with a namespace
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./k8s --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace my-namespace

instruction: How to update an ArgoCD application's destination namespace
output: argocd app set my-app --dest-namespace new-namespace

instruction: How to update an ArgoCD application's destination server
output: argocd app set my-app --dest-server https://new-cluster:6443

instruction: How to update an ArgoCD application's source repo
output: argocd app set my-app --repo https://github.com/another/repo.git

instruction: How to update an ArgoCD application's source path
output: argocd app set my-app --path ./new-path

instruction: How to update an ArgoCD application's source revision
output: argocd app set my-app --revision develop

instruction: How to set an ArgoCD application to use Kustomize
output: argocd app set my-app --path ./kustomize

instruction: How to set an ArgoCD application to use Helm
output: argocd app set my-app --repo https://charts.example.com --helm-chart mychart

instruction: How to set an ArgoCD application to use a plain YAML directory
output: argocd app set my-app --path ./yamls

instruction: How to enable Kustomize build options on an ArgoCD application
output: argocd app set my-app --kustomize-option loadRestrictor=LoadRestrictionsNone

instruction: How to enable Helm skip CRDs on an ArgoCD application
output: argocd app set my-app --helm-skip-crds

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD with Google SSO
output:
kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"dex.config":"connectors:
- type: google
  id: google
  name: Google
  config:
    clientID: CLIENT_ID
    clientSecret: CLIENT_SECRET
    hostedDomains:
    - example.com"}}'

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD with GitHub SSO
output:
kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"dex.config":"connectors:
- type: github
  id: github
  name: GitHub
  config:
    clientID: CLIENT_ID
    clientSecret: CLIENT_SECRET
    orgs:
    - name: my-org"}}'

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD with GitLab SSO
output:
kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"dex.config":"connectors:
- type: gitlab
  id: gitlab
  name: GitLab
  config:
    clientID: CLIENT_ID
    clientSecret: CLIENT_SECRET
    baseURL: https://gitlab.example.com"}}'

instruction: How to configure ArgoCD with LDAP SSO
output:
kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"dex.config":"connectors:
- type: ldap
  id: ldap
  name: LDAP
  config:
    host: ldap.example.com:389
    bindDN: cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com
    bindPW: password
    userSearch:
      baseDN: ou=users,dc=example,dc=com
      filter: (uid=username)
      username: uid
      idAttr: uid
      emailAttr: mail
      nameAttr: cn"}}'
